fields.summary: check playbook's high-risk lane Validation Matrix unconditionally requires 'unit' proof with no docs-only carve-out — a markdown-only phase diff (e.g. thin-triggers: SKILL.md rewrites, no code surface) structurally cannot produce unit-test evidence, forcing every such gate through a human zharness intervention instead of a clean APPROVED. Matrix should either add a diff-content-aware exemption (no source files changed -> unit: n/a) or the playbook should name intervention as the expected path for docs-only high-risk phases instead of leaving it implicit. Found gating thin-triggers phase via check full.
